jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Product Owner
jobs.description:
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Specialist, Product Owner to join our Data & Analytics team. This role is located in Boston, MA or New York, NY.
The Senior Specialist will help turn enterprise data into trusted, reusable, and client-consumable data products. The role will coordinate across Product, Engineering, Data Governance, Operations, and Client Delivery teams to support the full data-product lifecycle, from intake and prioritization through certification, documentation, delivery, adoption, and ongoing change management.
The successful candidate will combine strong data-management knowledge with practical execution skills. They will help establish clear operating standards, bring visibility to cross-team dependencies, and ensure data products are governed, documented, and ready for use by internal and external consumers.
In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:
- Coordinate the end-to-end onboarding and enablement of data products, including intake, scope definition, ownership alignment, metadata readiness, governance review, certification, provisioning, testing, documentation, and release readiness.
- Partner across Product, Engineering, Data Governance, Operations, Platform, and Client Delivery teams to define responsibilities, manage dependencies, align sequencing, and clarify decision and escalation paths.
- Develop and maintain reusable operating standards, playbooks, data dictionaries, process flows, decision records, and stakeholder-facing documentation to improve consistency and reduce reliance on manual or informal knowledge.
- Drive adoption of scalable delivery patterns by helping teams move from one-off solutions toward reusable data models, governed provisioning approaches, and standardized platform capabilities.
- Apply product management discipline, data fluency, and stakeholder feedback to inform roadmap priorities, measure value delivery, and continuously improve data capabilities that support decision-making, operational efficiency, and strategic outcomes.

To be successful in this role, we're seeking the following:
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in data management, information systems, business analysis, finance, technology, or a related discipline.
- Relevant experience in data product management, data governance, business analysis, technology delivery, or a related field within a complex organization.
- Experience coordinating initiatives across business, product, engineering, governance, operations, and client-facing teams.
- Experience working with tools that support workflow, metadata, reporting, and collaboration, such as Collibra, JIRA, Power BI, Snowflake, SharePoint, or similar platforms.
- Practical knowledge of data-governance concepts, including metadata, data lineage, data quality, authoritative data, stewardship, ownership, controls, data contracts, and certification.
- Experience with cloud data platforms, semantic models, knowledge graphs, data marketplaces, APIs, or AI-ready data practices is a plus.

This SVP will be a key platform role —shaping the 3 year plan, delivering complex insights and analysis, accelerating AI enabled transformation, and deputizing for the EPO where appropriate. The role collaborates closely with the locally based Head of Operations, and the Heads of Product and Engineering based in Pune.

Build scalability and first class client experience into reconciliations workflows.
In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:
Impact You Will Own
- Own and co‑author the 3‑year platform plan: target state, strategic intents, OKRs, and value realization roadmap.
- Convert complexity into clarity: produce executive‑ready analyses, narratives, and recommendations that guide investment and prioritization.
- Embed data intelligence and agentic AI into operating workflows to improve match rates, reduce exceptions, and elevate control quality.
- Strengthen governance and execution discipline: establish performance cadences, KPI frameworks, risk/issue logs, and dependency maps.
- Deputize for the EPO in key forums, reviews, and stakeholder engagements to maintain momentum and alignment.

Key Responsibilities Strategy and Target State
- Help the platform team set the north‑star vision for reconciliations (process, data, controls, user journeys) and translate into executable roadmaps.
- Drive AI adoption across the Platform
- Align the strategy across technology, operations, risk, and finance; articulate outcomes, milestones, and measurable benefits.

Insights and Decision Support
- Lead complex quantitative/qualitative analyses: throughput/capacity modelling, unit economics, SLA/defect metrics, productivity, and client impacts.
- Stand up KPI frameworks, dashboards, and narrative packs; track benefits realization versus plan and highlight trade‑offs.

AI‑Enabled Transformation and Engineering Partnership
- Identify and validate AI/ML opportunities (e.g., anomaly detection, match optimization, exception triage); design-controlled pilots and scale proven solutions.
- Partner with engineering to prioritize capabilities, ensure backlog quality, and define non‑functional requirements (resilience, controls, scalability).
- Align data strategy (sources, lineage, quality, governance) to enable analytics and model deployment.

Operating Model, Governance, and Controls
- Run execution cadence (quarterly strategy reviews, monthly performance packs) and maintain decision/risk/issue registers.
- Coordinate with control partners to ensure readiness across process, data, and change controls; adhere to model risk and operational risk practices.

Stakeholder Leadership and Communication
- Collaborate across firm‑wide stakeholders (Operations, Technology, Risk, Finance, Client teams) to unblock decisions and drive outcomes.
- Communicate crisply to senior audiences; make clear recommendations with action plans and measurable success criteria.

Skills & Behaviours (Aligned to BNY Principles)
- Be Client Obsessed: Understand client products and drivers; anticipate needs and improve experience through swift issue resolution.
- Spark Progress: Challenge the status quo; turn insights into experiments and improvements.
- Own It: End‑to‑end accountability for data quality, rules, and exception outcomes—issues surface because controls worked.
- Stay Curious: Continuously explore AI and analytics to enhance reconciliations; test, learn, and iterate.
- Thrive Together: Collaborate across stakeholders and share knowledge; build trust and momentum.
- AI Literacy: Apply agentic AI/ML where feasible; design for scale and controlled adoption.
- Product Mindset: Measure outcomes, simplify processes, and scale solutions.
- Design Thinking & Agile: Journey mapping, iterative delivery, and experimentation.
- Data & Analytics: Data mining, visualization, and storytelling to drive decisions.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:
Essential
- 10+ years in platform strategy, product/transformation, or operations within financial services; reconciliations/post‑trade experience preferred.
- Proven track record delivering complex analyses and executive‑ready insights; expert at structuring problems and data‑driven decisions.
- Hands‑on partnership with engineering on platform roadmaps and agile delivery; strong grasp of backlog management and NFRs.
- Practical exposure to AI/ML in operations or risk; able to translate business problems into testable hypotheses and measurable pilots.
- Strong financial acumen (business cases, benefit tracking) and operational metrics (SLA, throughput, quality, controls).
- Exceptional written/verbal communication, executive presence, and cross‑functional stakeholder management.
- Thrives as a high‑impact sole contributor; proactive, accountable, and comfortable deputizing senior leadership.

Preferred
- Custody operations, reconciliations, exceptions management, or middle‑office experience.
- Data fluency (SQL/BI/Prompt Engineering), KPI/dashboard design, data quality frameworks, and measurement discipline.
- Familiarity with control environments and change practices relevant to AI‑enabled operations.

- Manchester‑based; collaborates closely with the Head of Operations, Product and Engineering leadership.
- Operates with transparent execution cadence (OKRs, reviews, dashboards, risk logs) aligned to BNY’s Strategic Pillars: Be More for our Clients, Run our Company Better, Power our Culture.

Director, Product Design
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Director, Product Design to join our Digital Channels team. This role is located in Pune.
In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:
The experienced Design Director will lead and shape the design vision, strategy, and execution of one of our most critical spaces within BNY. This role will be pivotal in defining user experiences that deliver exceptional value to clients, driving user-centered designs, and pushing for elegant design solutions to highly complex problems. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in UX design, user research, and system thinking, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams.
Design Leadership & Strategy: Serve as the primary UX and design subject matter expert for our product, influencing design direction and decisions. Develop and implement design strategies that align with the firm's business goals, ensuring design excellence in all of our deliverables. Lead and mentor other designers, fostering growth and professional development.
User Research & Insights: Guide the execution of comprehensive user research, including surveys, interviews, and heuristic evaluations. Define and review user personas and translate research findings into actionable insights. Advocate for integrating user feedback and insights to continuously improve user experiences.
Interaction & Information Design: Drive the creation of elegant workflows and patterns that champion exceptional customer experiences. Oversee the creation of concepts, wireframes, storyboards, and prototypes to support product design goals.
Visual/UI Design: Direct and implement engaging visual styles that drive the value of our products and show exceptional craftsmanship. Act as a custodian of user interface and visual design standards, ensuring an ever-increasing quality of design excellence.
Design Systems & Standards: Contribute to and refine our design systems, guidelines, and standards to ensure scalability and efficiency. Provide thoughtful strategy and insights on how to work with a large-scale design system while maintaining product flexibility and creativity.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build strong relationships with key stakeholders, product managers, engineers, and cross-functional teams to align design initiatives with business and technical goals. Act as a design ambassador, promoting user-centered design principles and the importance of design in achieving business success.
Thought Leadership & Advocacy: Act as a champion for user-centered design, providing guidance to teams outside the design team. Stay ahead of industry trends, continuously fine-tuning expertise in UX and design practices.
Communication & Influence: Present design strategies, insights, and decisions to senior leadership, driving consensus and buy-in. Foster a culture of innovation and collaboration, inspiring teams to deliver their best work.
A portfolio is required to be considered for this position
This portfolio should demonstrate some or most of the expertise described above. While process is extremely important, a portfolio should demonstrate a high-quality end product that you’re proud of leading. A portfolio could include a Figma link that’s open to view access.
To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:
Typically, a candidate at this level has 12+ years of experience and some previous experience in regulated/complex spaces like finance, health or insurance.
